text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Royce and Royce, 
we stopped in front of a suit outlet—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What are you looking at? ...Ah, my suit. 
Did a particular design catch your eye?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking that you always wear 
the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Why not buy a few more? It'll give things 
a fresh feel, so I think it's a great 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right! I have the perfect outfit for 
this. Let me show you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's the flagship store of 'Antonio'— a 
world-famous brand I'm totally obsessed 
with!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without being a fashion expert, I 
recognize it. It's a famous designer brand 
where a single outfit costs two months' 
salary.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's a suit Dad's always dreamed of 
owning, too. He tried to convince Mom by 
saying, 'It's essential gear for battling 
through the rough seas of society!' ♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look at that two-piece in the display 
window. That would look so lovely on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it is lovely, but...

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey. Isn't that suit a little too 
flashy?”

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Some of the seniors might not look kindly 
upon it, so I think you'd better change."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The advice I once received from a 
classmate flashes through my mind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I wear an expensive suit, it might 
draw unwanted attention. That felt like 
quite a hassle."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ? Is something wrong?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, clothes from a department store 
might just be easier for me to wear...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. No, there is no need to 
apologize. After all, you are the one 
actually buying it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hey, would you mind keeping me company a 
little longer? There's somewhere I'd like 
to drop by before heading back to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Hands-on Learning! The History of Antonio 
Exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I saw the promotional poster and was 
curious about it. It must be fate! Shall 
we take a look?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So this is the very first piece 
made when the brand was founded. And the 
one next to it is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: !? W-What is this mountain of stuff...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There, heaps of fabric were piled up high, 
looming like towering cliffs!
choice_data_list:
Are all of these prototypes... Never 
say...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To think there's someone else like that 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm talking about you. Look at you, 
surrounded by piles of race documents.
choice_data_list:
I see... That makes me feel a bit closer 
to you.

I see... That makes me feel a bit closer 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Incredible. They even have letters 
addressed to "Antonio" on display.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Know your place as newcomers. Your suits 
are disgracefully commercialized. Cease 
production immediately and fall in line 
with the rest of us—"

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're a rookie Trainer, aren't you? Save 
the lofty ideals until after you've built 
up some experience!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having no experience, only passion. 
Precisely because I was such a rookie, 
there were walls that I, too, had to hit.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What intense content. Antonio, you did 
well not to give in.
choice_data_list:
...I'm sure they had an ideal they wanted 
to fulfill.

...I'm sure they had an ideal they wanted 
to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following the tour route, the next stop 
was the theater room."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"I'm sure you all felt it too. Yes. 
Antonio was a humble tailor, but he burned 
with passion."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Higher quality fabrics, more elegant 
designs. Refusing to yield to our 
competitors' sabotage, we stayed true to 
our ideals in this small workshop. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It has now become a major suit brand, 
delivering special garments to people all 
across the world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, allow me to share the words of 
our founder— 'We dedicate this suit to all 
who fight.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wall standing before our ideals is 
tall and steep. There will surely be 
painful and difficult times. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will never surrender the title of 
"strongest"—
choice_data_list: —Royce, there's somewhere I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought. It suits you well, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You've made up your mind... I take it 
that's what this means, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing 'Antonio' is synonymous with 
donning an unyielding spirit."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Senior or not, whoever they are— if I 
want to surpass them, I can't afford to 
hold back."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Fufu. Of course, I'll be 
right there with you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"We are the 'strongest' Umamusume and the 
'strongest' Trainer!"
choice_data_list:
Let's just wear it all the time from now 
on!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So that's how determined you are. I think 
that's wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No matter the time or place, always keep 
the mindset of the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll renew my resolve too. I'm gonna climb 
to the top, just like "Antonio"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufufufu! Oh, you. You were acting 
so cool just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I'll help you think of ways to 
save money! Ehehe.
